Regular.retrieval: FontTools name table and sha256sum of the shipped bytes; curl -fsSL <immutable raw font URL> | sha256sum

Bold.retrieval: FontTools name table and sha256sum of the shipped bytes; curl -fsSL <immutable raw font URL> | sha256sum

Italic.retrieval: FontTools name table and sha256sum of the shipped bytes; curl -fsSL <immutable raw font URL> | sha256sum

license.retrieval: curl -fsSL <immutable raw OFL.txt URL> | sha256sum; the complete bytes are embedded in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt

JetBrainsMono.note: The three shipped WOFF2 files are byte-identical to the cited immutable v2.305 source files. The embedded font name table identifies SIL Open Font License 1.1; the upstream CSS Apache-2.0 comment is inconsistent and is not used as license evidence.
